The coordination number of Co in the complex [Co(en) Br ]Cl is 6
 2 2 2
en (ethylene diamine) is a bidentate ligand while bromine is a monodentate ligand.
C.N. of Co = 2× number of bidentate ligand +1× number of monodentate ligand
= 2 × 2 + 1 × 2 = 6
Hence, the answer is 6.
